page.layout: One printed page on the left, title page with large central lines and small lines below. The right edge shows show-through and the edge of the facing page, which are not transcribed. A library stamp sits in the centre.
page.notes: The title page is very faint and largely unreadable on the scan. The large capitals appear to read "...STITVTIONES" (possibly "INSTITVTIONES"), and a line below reads "...LICÆ". The smaller lines in the middle and lower part cannot be read with confidence, so they are marked illegible. The right-hand strip shows mirrored show-through and the edge of the facing page (fragments such as "D. FRANC...", "EQVIT...", "ACAD..."), which are not transcribed. The Wellcome Historical Medical Library stamp, the digitiser's credit line and the scan frame are excluded. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible.
